name: @navis/infrastructure
description: Navis infrastructure adapters implementing domain and application ports.

scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.json --pretty false && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync, cpSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist/persistence/postgres/migrations', { recursive: true, force: true }); cpSync('src/persistence/postgres/migrations', 'dist/persistence/postgres/migrations', { recursive: true });"
